fields.summary: Autonomous plan run, no owner. The planner traced the bug: the plan-review runs of milestone 26's drafts (runs 01M6KYKJ on 01M6J375 and 01M6KZ9E on 01M6J37D, 2026-11-04) were owner-queued starts (rhiza run start with a plan-review workflow file), which daemonQueuedStarts starts up to max-runs after ship picks and continuations but before daemonPlanRequests; only ship picks honoured the slot kept for a waiting plan request (#226), so request 01M6KTAZ (queued 17:40) waited until 19:19. Two questions went to the arbiter: the fix (queued starts keep the slot, or plan requests before queued starts) and the intent. The arbiter decided queued-starts-keep-request-slot: while a queued plan request could start and max > 1, queued starts start only while running < max-1; poll order unchanged; the change set serves milestone-25. The planner wrote one leaf under plan-requests.
fields.title: Plan of Fix Plan-review runs of drafts (autonomous)
